text: susammuṭṭhasuttaṃ [17] ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi #1 sī. appaṭividhitā . 2 sī. ma. niyyare . 3 yu. te sambuddhā sammadaññā . yesaṃ dhammā susammuṭṭhā paravādesu nīyare suttā te nappabujjhanti kālo tesaṃ pabujjhitunti . [18] yesaṃ dhammā asammuṭṭhā paravādesu na nīyare sambuddhā sammadaññāya caranti visame samanti . navamaṃ
